name: metrictower/funnypot-app
description: funnypot-app: a standalone multi-protocol honeypot. HTTP nuclei-inversion deception (via funnypot-core) plus SSH, telnet, redis, mysql and 14 more TCP service emulators, with a live attacker dashboard.

scripts-descriptions.test: Full suite in parallel across all cores (~6s).
scripts-descriptions.test:fast: Parallel, minus the seeded-panel render tests (quickest smoke).
scripts-descriptions.test:serial: Full suite in a single process (debugging / deterministic ordering).
